Max Electric Inc. is a fully licensed and insured residential electrical contractor. We provide high-quality electrical services to our residential customers in the MidSouth.

Our highly trained residential electricians specialize in inspecting, repairing, and replacing the electrical in your home. It’s our job to make sure your home is free of electrical hazards and safe for you and your loved ones. Your safety is our #1 concern!
